metadata.title: Ejection of Hyper-Velocity Stars from the Galactic Centre by Intermediate-Mass Black Holes

notes: No eligible individual stars are identifiable from the supplied material. The paper presents N-body simulations of hyper-velocity-star populations rather than studies of named stars; observed HVS are mentioned only collectively or anonymously (T:p1-b9, T:p6-b8, T:p8-b5), and the anonymous LMC-related star at T:p1-b9 has no supplied star identifier and no explicit retained Galactic-unbound assessment.
